name: AARP® Travel Rewards Mastercard® from Barclays

localized_names.en: AARP® Travel Rewards Mastercard® from Barclays

apr.notes: 0% introductory APR for 15 months on balance transfers made within 45 days of account opening. After that, variable APR 20.24% to 29.99% on purchases and balance transfers. Cash advance variable APR 29.99%. Minimum monthly interest charge $1.00. Balance transfer fee 5% (min $5). Cash advance fee 5% (min $10).

fx_fee.notes: No foreign transaction fees on international purchases.

base_rate.description: 1% cash back on all other purchases (1 cent per dollar).

rewards.redemption_notes: Rewards can be redeemed for cash back, statement credits, AARP memberships, gift cards, and merchandise. AARP memberships can be redeemed for yourself or as a gift, starting at $16 in rewards. Unlimited rewards that never expire as long as account is open and in good standing.

signup_bonus.description: Earn a $100 cash back bonus after spending $500 on purchases in the first 90 days from account opening.

benefits.title: Unlimited Rewards That Never Expire
benefits.description: There's no limit to the amount of rewards you can earn, and they'll never expire as long as your account is open and in good standing.

benefits.title: $0 Fraud Liability Protection
benefits.description: You'll never be responsible for unauthorized charges made on your account.

benefits.title: Flexible Redemption Options
benefits.description: Rewards can be redeemed for cash back, statement credits, AARP memberships, gift cards, and merchandise. AARP memberships can be redeemed for yourself or as a gift, starting at $16 in rewards.

benefits.title: Low Intro Rate on Balance Transfers
benefits.description: 0% introductory APR for 15 months on balance transfers made within 45 days of account opening. After that, a variable APR will apply, 20.24% to 29.99%.

benefits.title: No Foreign Transaction Fees
benefits.description: No foreign transaction fees on international purchases.

benefits.title: AARP Foundation Donation
benefits.description: Barclays will donate $10 to AARP Foundation for every new AARP-branded credit card account that's opened, plus 1% of all eligible electronic and telecommunications purchases made with the card, up to $1 million annually.

other: No foreign transaction fees on international purchases

notes: Verified from official Barclays co-brand partner site. Annual fee $0, purchase APR 20.24%-29.99% variable, cash advance 29.99% variable, FX fee 0%. Rewards: 3% on airfare/hotel/car rentals, 2% on restaurants, 1% on all other purchases. $100 cash back bonus after $500 spend in 90 days.
